title: The Crown's Due
subtitle: Paid even while the payouts are held
description: An operator can hold every automatic payout with
`/tasked rewards block`, and the hold outranks every mode. What the
hold does not outrank is this: `ignoreRewardBlocking: true` gives
the crown's share even while the rest of the vault sits behind the
block, which is the difference between a hold and an embargo.
The command below is the loud kind -- it says so in chat, with
`{p}` and `{quest}` filled in. An unknown brace-word is left as
written rather than blanked, so a typo in a placeholder is one
second of reading and not a mystery.

rewards.command: say {p} settled the crown's due on {quest}
